detailed_description: The Positive Negative Bar Chart Generator helps you show values above and below a shared baseline so direction and magnitude are both obvious. It is a useful format for gains versus losses, over-target versus under-target performance, or favorable versus unfavorable responses. You can enter signed values, set colors for both directions, adjust labels and legend settings, and export the final chart as PNG or SVG after checking the live preview.
usage_steps: Add categories and positive or negative values in the chart editor.
Set the title and confirm the baseline direction matches how you want to explain the comparison.
Choose separate colors for positive and negative bars so the split is clear at a glance.
Review the preview and adjust labels, spacing, or order if the zero-line comparison feels busy.
Export the completed positive negative bar chart as PNG or SVG for slides, dashboards, or reports.
usage_examples: Show monthly profit and loss across teams in one comparison chart.
Visualize sentiment results where positive and negative responses need equal emphasis.
Compare performance against target by category to highlight where results are above or below plan.
